::: {.content-visible when-format="pdf"}

~~~{=latex}
\begin{algorithm}[H]
\small\setstretch{1}\DontPrintSemicolon
\caption{\addition{$\mathrm{SafeguardedSupportStep}(\beta,\sigma)$ (optional)}}
\label{alg:polish}
\KwInput{$q_N,K_N\in\mathbb N_+,\ c_H,c_A>0,\ \omega\in(0,1)$}
\addition{
$J\leftarrow\{j:\beta_j\ne0\}\cup\{j:j\ \mathrm{unpenalized}\}$\;
\If{$|J|=0\ \mathrm{or}\ |J|>q_N$}{\KwReturn{$(\beta,\sigma)$}}
$z\leftarrow(\beta_J,\sigma)$;\quad
$g\leftarrow\nabla_J F_{\lambda_0}(\beta,\sigma)$;\quad
$H\leftarrow\nabla_J^2 F_{\lambda_0}(\beta,\sigma)$\;
$\mu\leftarrow c_H\max_j H_{jj}$\;
\If{$\mu=0$}{\KwReturn{$(\beta,\sigma)$}}
$d\leftarrow-(H+\mu I)^{-1}g$\;
\If{$g^\top d\ge0$}{\KwReturn{$(\beta,\sigma)$}}
\For{$m=0,\ldots,K_N-1$}{
 $t\leftarrow\omega^m$;\quad $(\beta_J^+,\sigma^+)\leftarrow z+td$;\quad
 $\beta_{J^c}^+\leftarrow0$\;
 \If{$\sigma^+>0\ \mathrm{and}\ F_{\lambda_0}(\beta^+,\sigma^+)
     \le F_{\lambda_0}(\beta,\sigma)+c_A t g^\top d$}{
  \KwReturn{$(\beta^+,\sigma^+)$}
 }
}
\KwReturn{$(\beta,\sigma)$}
}
\end{algorithm}
~~~

:::

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

The support step solves $(H+c_H\max_j H_{jj}I)d=-g$. It tests step lengths
$\omega^m$, $m=0,\ldots,K_N-1$, retaining the first positive-scale point
satisfying $F(z+\omega^m d)\le F(z)+c_A\omega^m g^\top d$. If the
support exceeds $q_N$, the direction is not a descent direction, or every
trial fails, it retains the coefficient/MM iterate.

:::
